items.title: makeRealLoopAgent: multi-turn claude -p, honors AbortSignal, hardened parsing
items.context: Per turn: execFileSync claude -p --output-format json on {ws,context} (cwd=ws), parse via parseClaudeResult (non-JSON/API-error -> infra-fail; type-safe cost); on signal.aborted kill the child / stop; return {actions,shipped,output,costUsd,tokensSpent}. Reuse B-0c07 parsing + B-c023 signal contract; no run-recovery import. + a no-LLM stub multi-turn agent for the hermetic self-check.
items.userSees: ✓ makeRealLoopAgent({model}) -> agent({ws,context,turn,signal}) runs claude -p per turn (parseClaudeResult-hardened), honors signal.aborted (kills its child), returns {actions,shipped,output,costUsd,tokensSpent}; + a no-LLM stub multi-turn agent for the hermetic self-check.

happy.desc: the stub multi-turn agent drives runLiveLoop turns + mutates the ws per scenario; classify yields the expected OUTCOME; WHY: proves the real-agent contract shape + the --run wiring deterministically.

edge.desc: parseClaudeResult is reused so a non-JSON/API-error turn -> infra-fail (recorded, batch continues); WHY: robust + data not corrupted.

adversarial.desc: the agent receives {signal}; a slow stub agent under a tiny timeout aborts (signal.aborted observed) so the real agent can kill its child; WHY: honors the B-c023 termination contract.

items.title: --run powered driver + hermetic stub self-check
items.context: --run drives the 9 stateful scenarios (B3/B4/B5/B7/B8/B10/B12/B14/B15) via runLiveLoop with the real agent, appends {scenario,outcome,turns,costUsd,tokensSpent} to live-loop-powered-records.jsonl, prints per-scenario outcomes + a summary; honest small-N/exploratory caveat. --self-check (stub agent, 0 spend) verifies the --run wiring + record schema + signal honoring deterministically. The real powered run is operator-triggered (cost-gated).
items.userSees: ✓ --run drives the 9 stateful scenarios via the real agent -> live-loop-powered-records.jsonl (+ small-N/exploratory caveat); --self-check (stub agent, 0 spend) verifies the --run wiring + record schema + signal honoring; the real powered run is operator-triggered.

happy.desc: --self-check stub multi-turn run over the 9 scenarios records {scenario,outcome,turns,...} for each; the existing 23 hermetic cases still pass; WHY: the powered path is wiring-verified hermetically.

edge.desc: --run is the ONLY path that calls the real agent; --self-check makes no claude call (0 spend); the real run prints + records a small-N/exploratory caveat; WHY: hermetic gate + honest labeling.

adversarial.desc: a stub agent that ships an unsafe state is still classified AMPLIFIED (classify reads real signals), so the --run path can't be gamed by a self-reporting agent; WHY: sound powered classification.
